payload.text: dc's one Desk booking, from devbin-vc's Desk on rhadamanth once devbin-vc's sweep of devbin 0.1.23 has landed in Intent and vc calls it. Every step runs one after the other and none beside a kovacs run (hv decision 45). (1) Hold 41's WP-06 proof run: the v3 bank rebased onto the sweep, its arms red then green, and the bats suite at N=24 with its serial lane. (2) 0682's by-hand bin/devbin gate rust with TMPDIR on a 1.7G disk image, mounted for the run and then detached and deleted. (3) dc banks, and vc lands WP-06 with 0682's Resolution and close. (4) bin/devbin release gates --leg kovacs. (5) The dry run, whose pre-flight runs no gate. Before (5), vc calls a freeze: every seat commits its board, and then nothing writes to Intent's tree until hv's cut has finished, not even a pickup, which writes the heartbeat. vc confirms git status is empty before dc starts (5). intentd stays up through the whole slot and no seat stops it (hv decision 46, 5e7ebf01d). So (5) stops at its pre-flight step, which still runs every check and names every refusal. It passes when the live daemon is the only refusal; any other refusal is a finding, and dc brings it to vc. The rows after the pre-flight first print in hv's own dry run at the cut, after hv stops intentd (releasing.md step 0). releasing.md step 2's commits are in: def0a8e01, bd525bae2, 7c6bfa53d and 573f817b2. The booking waits for the sweep's commit and vc's call (vc, 2026-11-12).
